dailyTip.title: Tip of the day
tips: I still need my 30 minutes outside today. Grab the leash.
My water bowl's empty again. Fill it up before I start complaining.
Feed me at the same time every day, my stomach keeps better track than you do.
If I get bored I chew things. Buy me a puzzle toy and save your shoes.
Brush me for a bit, I love it more than I let on.
Take me somewhere with other dogs, I've been cooped up too long.
I have a vet appointment coming up. Bring treats and I'll forgive you faster.
